packageRules.description: Require compatibility review for every major update
Keep the programmatic TypeScript API on the 6.x compatibility line
Keep the aliased native TypeScript CLI on the 7.x line
Hold npm in its own approval-gated branch: packageManager, devEngines, the baseline spec, and the toolchain check pin the exact reviewed release

Hold Next.js baseline framework packages in their own approval-gated branch: baseline/v1/spec.json and .github/nextjs-baseline.json enforce the exact versions (typescript also matches the @typescript/native alias)
